projects.name: skills
projects.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
projects.ai_summary: 该项目提供工程师实用技能集合，直接来自作者的.agents目录。采用Shell脚本实现，便于快速部署和使用。

projects.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
projects.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
projects.ai_summary: 该项目通过AI大模型实现自动化短视频生成，用户输入主题或关键词即可输出高清视频。基于Python构建，整合多模态AI工作流实现端到端内容生产。

projects.name: career-ops
projects.description: Open-source AI job search: scan job portals, evaluate listings with a structured A-F rubric into a 1.0-5.0 score, tailor your CV, track applications — runs locally in your AI coding CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity…)
projects.ai_summary: 该项目是开源的AI求职辅助工具，能自动扫描职位、评估匹配度并优化简历。使用JavaScript开发，支持在本地AI编程环境中运行，集成多模型评分系统。

projects.name: superpowers
projects.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
projects.ai_summary: Superpowers 是一个代理技能框架和软件开发方法论，旨在提升开发效率。采用 Shell 脚本实现，强调技能组合与流程优化。

projects.name: ECC
projects.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
projects.ai_summary: ECC 是针对 Claude 等 AI 代码助手的性能优化系统，涵盖技能、记忆和安全模块。基于 JavaScript 实现，采用研究优先的开发范式。

projects.name: posthog
projects.description: 🦔 PostHog is the leading platform for building self-driving products. Our developer tools – AI observability, analytics, session replay, flags, experiments, error tracking, logs, and more – capture all the context agents need to diagnose problems, uncover opportunities, and ship fixes. Steer it all from Slack, web, desktop, or the MCP.
projects.ai_summary: PostHog 是面向自驱动产品的全栈观测平台，集成分析、回放、实验等工具。基于 Python 构建，支持多终端访问与上下文智能诊断。

projects.name: maka
projects.description: Apache Maka (Incubating) is a local-first AI agent workspace. Model messages, tool calls, tool results, permission decisions, and termination events are recorded as an append-only log.
projects.ai_summary: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作区，用于记录模型消息、工具调用、权限决策等事件。采用 TypeScript 实现，所有操作记录为仅追加日志，确保数据不可篡改。

projects.name: ruflo
projects.description: 🌊 The original agent meta-harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
projects.ai_summary: Ruflo 是智能多代理系统的元框架，支持部署自主工作流和构建对话式 AI 系统。基于 TypeScript 实现，具备自适应内存、自学习能力，并原生集成 Claude Code/Codex/Hermes 等多种模型。

projects.name: diagram-design
projects.description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
projects.ai_summary: 提供 38 种面向 Claude Code/Codex/Pi 的编辑图表类型。采用纯 HTML+SVG 实现，无阴影效果，避免 Mermaid 图表常见的渲染问题。

projects.name: OpenViking
projects.description: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
projects.ai_summary: OpenViking 是一个为 AI 代理设计的自演进上下文数据库，旨在统一代理记忆、知识检索增强生成（RAG）和技能管理。该项目基于 Python 实现，采用自演进架构以动态适应和优化代理的上下文数据存储与检索。
